d:
LOSC Lille and Stade Brestois fought out an intense, hard-fought 1-1 draw in Ligue 1 action!
Mama Baldé struck early in the 6th minute to stun the home crowd and give Brest a deserving early lead. The visitors defended resolutely for much of the match, but Lille's persistent pressure finally paid off in the second half. Olivier Giroud kept his cool to convert a 64th-minute penalty, leveling the scores and ensuring both sides earned a point from the encounter!
